thread:
Ava Chen: quick pulse — we need to lock the year-ahead roadmap workshop schedule. i sketched a 2-day flow, want people to sign up for facilitation slots by EOD Friday.
Diego Morales: sounds good. can we keep day 1 heavy on problem framing + customer signals and day 2 on prioritization and OKR drafts?
Priya Nair: +1. also want 45m for vendor Q&A that product partnerships asked for — do we tuck that into day 2 AM or run as a lunchtime drop-in?
Samir Patel: lunchtime drop-in seems least disruptive. we should avoid vendor sessions during prioritization games.
Jordan Lee: for facilitation roles: I'll take morning cadence/check-ins on day 1. need someone to run the "prioritization games" on day 2 (buy-a-feature + dot voting). who wants that?
Ruth Gomez: I can run dot-vote flow and collect scores into the shared sheet.
Ava Chen: perfect — Samir do you want to own buy-a-feature facilitation? it's a light script.
Samir Patel: yeah I can run buy-a-feature. can someone prep the constraint cards? (cost, infra, privacy, time-to-market)
Priya Nair: i'll draft constraint cards and examples from customer requests. will post to the prep doc tonight.
Diego Morales: logistics: room request submitted but need AV (mics + spot projector) and 2 breakout rooms. anyone with AV stories?
Jordan Lee: AV team replied: we can get 2 wireless mics and 1 table mic, projector reserved. need a headcount by Monday.
Ava Chen: headcount ~ 28. also catering for 1.5 days — lunch + coffee. budget ok? finance sign-off pending.
planning-bot: reminder: add event to calendar with "No External Recording" flag if customer stories are sensitive.
Ruth Gomez: facilitation checklist idea: intro + norms (10m), signal review (30m), customer spotlights (40m), mapping + themes (60m), lunch, prioritization games (90m), synth + draft OKRs (60m).
Samir Patel: timebox the prioritization games strictly — we often overrun. propose a visible timer and a scribe for each table.
Priya Nair: prework for attendees: 1) bring 2 top customer issues, 2) one cost estimate / feasibility note from eng, 3) highlight metrics impacted. i'll send a template.
Diego Morales: can we include a lightweight rubric for launch-readiness: success metric, rollout complexity (low/med/high), data sensitivity? that'll help score during dot-vote.
Ava Chen: yes, add "launch-ready check" card. keep scores 0-5 for each axis.
Jordan Lee: question on external speakers — customer panel wants to present 20m. i'm leaning to one 20m slot on day 1. any objections?
Ruth Gomez: fine as long as customers agree to a Q&A cap (15m).
Samir Patel: ops ask: include a runbook owner for each proposal we prioritize (someone listed to shepherd to prototype).
Priya Nair: assign provisional owners during synth session; owners can opt out later but helps momentum.
Ava Chen: next actions: Priya to post prework + template by tonight; Ruth to create the dot-vote sheet and scoring tabs; Samir to draft buy-a-feature cards; Jordan to confirm AV + headcount; Diego to chase finance for catering approval. owners ack?
Diego Morales: ack.
Priya Nair: ack and will ping PMs for prework compliance.
Ruth Gomez: ack, will share sheet link in #product and pin it.
Samir Patel: ack, I'll draft cards and post examples.
Jordan Lee: ack — confirming AV and room; will update calendar invites after finance confirms lunch.
Ava Chen: thanks team — i'll compile a one-pager facilitation playbook and share before Monday. try to keep asks light so folks do prework. :sparkles:
planning-bot: event "Yearly Roadmap Workshop" created (2 days) — calendar invites will go out after headcount confirmed.
Ava Chen: if you want to volunteer as an icebreaker host or table scribe, drop a +1 on the doc. low-friction roles help a ton. :raised_hands:
